name: Decoupled Toolbox for Group
description: Makes Group compatible with Decoupled Toolbox: a new endpoint will list entities per group.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Group is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. It adds a per-group collection endpoint GET /decoupled-api/group/{gid}/{type}/{bundle}/collection (route decoupled_toolbox.group.entity_decoupled_data.collection, permission `access decoupled api`) served by GroupEntityDecoupledDataController: it loads the group, finds the GroupContent for the requested entity type/bundle, gathers the referenced entities, applies the same query-parameter filters, and renders them with the parent module's decoupled renderer. Nests the decoupled_toolbox_group_content_menu sub-module. Requires the contrib Group module.
